# Shared agent memory — revision 42

Preferences and lessons, not authorization. Current user instructions and project facts take precedence.
Read-only files: /srv/demo/mnt/shared-agent-memory/ (index: INDEX.md). Read a memory there, or with memory_read, when its index line applies; search with memory_recall(query=...).

## Always apply
### Keep it simple: if a part can go, remove it [/global/keep-it-simple.md]
Every screen, control, setting, file and rule has to earn its place. When a part can be removed without losing what the user asked for, remove it. Prefer the plainer design even when reaching it takes longer, reuse existing libraries before writing new ones, and avoid knobs nobody asked for. Applies to code, documents, prompts and agent workflows alike.

How to apply: the agent follows this in every session; this memory outranks habit.

### Sync conflicts keep both copies [/projects/home/demo/work/notes-app/sync-conflict-policy.md]
When two devices edit the same note offline, the notes app keeps both versions and marks the newer one as current. Never merge note bodies automatically, because an automatic merge silently loses text the user typed.

### Check unfamiliar mechanisms before relying on them [/global/research-before-relying.md]
Before building on a feature, tool, library or device behaviour the agent has not used before, read the upstream documentation and open issues, or compare two or three existing open-source projects that solve the same problem. Record what was checked and why the chosen approach fits. Mark any claim that could not be checked as unverified instead of stating it as fact.

How to apply: an agent that finds this memory outdated records an observation for the next dream.

### Lead with the result, in plain words [/global/talk-plainly.md]
Open with the outcome or the recommendation. Give one recommendation rather than a survey of options. When the user asks to explain what is happening, explain and take no action in that turn. Correct an earlier claim as soon as it proves wrong, and state what was not verified.

How to apply: the agent checks this memory before acting and tells the user when it does not fit.

## This project
### Release checklist for the notes app [/projects/home/demo/work/notes-app/release-checklist.md]
Bump the version in one place, run the full test suite and the offline sync scenario, build the signed bundle, then tag. The changelog entry is written before the tag, never after.

### Schema migrations run forward only [/projects/home/demo/work/notes-app/schema-migrations.md]
Each SQLite schema change is a numbered forward migration with a test that upgrades a copy of the previous release's database. There are no down migrations; a bad migration is fixed by a new one.

### Web bundle stays under 200 kB [/projects/home/demo/work/notes-app/web/bundle-size-budget.md]
The web client's compressed JavaScript bundle stays under 200 kB. A pull request that crosses the budget names what it added and what it removed to pay for it.

### Test commands for the notes app [/projects/home/demo/work/notes-app/test-commands.md]
Run the unit suite with the default test command and the sync scenarios with the scenario runner. Scenario tests start two simulated devices on temporary directories and never touch the real data folder.

### Interface copy is reviewed by reading it aloud [/projects/home/demo/work/notes-app/ui-copy-review.md]
Every button label and message is read aloud once before merge. If it sounds like a system talking to itself, rewrite it in the user's words.

## Requested
### Coordinators delegate implementation to teammates [/roles/coordinator/coordinate-a-team.md]
A coordinator staffs an architect, engineers with disjoint file ownership and test engineers, each in its own worktree, and does only small reads and checks itself.

How to apply: an agent that finds this memory outdated records an observation for the next dream.

### Raspberry Pi 5 USB ports share one power switch [/topics/hardware/raspberry-pi-usb-power.md]
On a Raspberry Pi 5 the USB ports cannot be power-cycled one at a time; switching power affects all of them together. Plan device resets around a powered hub with per-port switching instead.

How to apply: when the user corrects this, the agent updates the memory the same day.

### Burmese text needs a Unicode font, not Zawgyi [/topics/burmese/burmese-font-rendering.md]
Render Burmese with a Unicode-conformant font such as Noto Sans Myanmar. Text like မြန်မာစာ must display stacked consonants correctly; legacy Zawgyi encoded input is converted before storage.

How to apply: the agent follows this in every session; this memory outranks habit.

### Transliterate Burmese names consistently [/topics/burmese/burmese-transliteration.md]
Use one transliteration table for Burmese personal names across the interface and exports, so မောင် is always written Maung and never mixed with older spellings.

How to apply: an agent that finds this memory outdated records an observation for the next dream.

### Only the coordinator merges approved pull requests [/roles/coordinator/merge-one-approval-point.md]
Teammates send the coordinator the approved pull request number and head commit. The coordinator checks the head is current and mergeable, merges it, and confirms the linked issue closed.

How to apply: the agent checks this memory before acting and tells the user when it does not fit.

### Serial console runs at 115200 baud [/topics/hardware/serial-console-baud.md]
Boards in this lab use 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, one stop bit. A garbled console almost always means a baud mismatch.

How to apply: an agent that finds this memory outdated records an observation for the next dream.

### Some SSD enclosures need UAS disabled [/topics/hardware/ssd-enclosure-quirks.md]
A few USB SSD enclosures drop off the bus under load with UAS enabled. Add a usb-storage quirk for the enclosure's vendor and product id and confirm the disk stays mounted through a long copy.

How to apply: the agent follows this in every session; this memory outranks habit.
